from tools.isolated_production_sync import rebase_validated_commit
base='4cf6235f4c2928a9b4cd538f16280318a8007456';label='v17-static-explicit-rebase-20261026'
initial=ROOT/'runtime/v17-static-progress-published-20261026.json';prior=read_json(initial);assert prior['status']=='publication_requires_inspection' and 'commit' not in prior
paths=list(prior['paths_and_sha256']);assert all(file_sha256(ROOT/p)==v for p,v in prior['paths_and_sha256'].items())
failure=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261026-v17-static-advanced-remote.json';assert not failure.exists();failure.write_bytes(initial.read_bytes());paths.append(failure.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
receipt_path=ROOT/'runtime/v17-static-rebased-published-20261026.json';assert not receipt_path.exists()

def git(*args,cwd=ROOT,env=None,check=True,timeout=240):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','gc.auto=0','-c','maintenance.auto=false',*args],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,env={**os.environ,'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0',**(env or {})})
 if check:assert p.returncode==0,(args,p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'),p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
 return p.stdout if check else p
lock=ROOT/'runtime/production-publish.lock';deadline=time.monotonic()+180
while True:
 try:fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY)
 except FileExistsError:
  if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise TimeoutError('Existing publisher retains lock; inspect owner')
  time.sleep(5)
 else:break
with os.fdopen(fd,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump({'machine_id':machine_id(),'process_id':os.getpid(),'batch':label,'acquired_at_utc':utc_now()},f)
try:
 assert git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip()=='master' and git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==base and not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
 git('fetch','origin','master');git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',base,'origin/master')
 git('diff','--check','--',*paths);git('add','--',*paths)
 staged=set(git('diff','--cached','--name-only').decode().splitlines());assert staged and staged<=set(paths)
 git('commit','-m','Record LOW production continuation and wall-hour results');old=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip();task_patch=git('diff','--binary',base,old);task_paths=set(git('diff','--name-only',base,old).decode().splitlines());assert task_paths==staged
 record.update(status='private_commit_requires_isolated_sync',original_private_commit=old,public_base=base,task_paths=sorted(task_paths),task_patch_sha256=hashlib.sha256(task_patch).hexdigest());write_json(receipt_path,record)
 try:sync=rebase_validated_commit(old,label)
 except RuntimeError:
  sync_path=ROOT/f'runtime/production-sync/{label}-{old[:12]}-receipt.json';sync=read_json(sync_path);assert sync['status']=='revalidation_required_after_remote_rebase'
 isolated=Path(sync['isolated_worktree']);record['initial_isolated_sync']=sync
 for attempt in range(1,5):
  git('fetch','origin','master');remote=git('rev-parse','origin/master').decode().strip();git('rebase','origin/master',cwd=isolated);new=git('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=isolated).decode().strip();parent=git('rev-parse',new+'^').decode().strip()
  assert parent==remote and git('diff','--binary',parent,new)==task_patch
  added=git('diff','--name-status',base,parent).decode().splitlines();assert all(x.startswith('A\tmod_nailong/assets/generated_fullsize/') and x.endswith('.png') for x in added),'Unexpected remote delta requires review'
  assert not {x.split('\t',1)[1] for x in added}&task_paths;git('diff','--check',parent,new)
  for path in task_paths:
   if path.endswith('.json'):json.loads(git('show',new+':'+path))
  p=git('-c','http.version=HTTP/1.1','push','origin',new+':refs/heads/master',check=False,timeout=900)
  record.setdefault('publication_attempts',[]).append({'attempt':attempt,'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'remote':remote,'rebased_commit':new,'identical_task_patch':True,'remote_only_added_PNG_count':len(added),'push_exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'),'stderr':p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')});write_json(receipt_path,record)
  if p.returncode==0:break
  assert any(x in p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace') for x in ['fetch first','non-fast-forward']),'Transport failure needs explicit inspection'
 else:raise RuntimeError('Remote advanced four times; preserve private commit')
 observed=git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/master').decode().split()[0]
 if observed!=new:git('fetch','origin','master');git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',new,observed)
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==old and not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
 gitdir=Path(git('rev-parse','--absolute-git-dir').decode().strip());index=gitdir/'index';indexlock=gitdir/'index.lock';assert not indexlock.exists()
 folder=ROOT/'runtime/v17-static-private-rebase-adoption-20261026';folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False);before=index.read_bytes();(folder/'original.index').write_bytes(before);alternate=folder/'stat-preserved.index';alternate.write_bytes(before);env={'GIT_INDEX_FILE':str(alternate)}
 git('read-tree','-i','-m',old,new,env=env);assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only',new,env=env).strip()
 def entries(data):
  magic,version,count=struct.unpack('>4sII',data[:12]);assert magic==b'DIRC' and version==2;pos=12;out={}
  for _ in range(count):
   start=pos;flags=struct.unpack('>H',data[pos+60:pos+62])[0];assert not flags&0x4000;end=data.index(b'\0',pos+62);out[data[pos+62:end].decode()]=(data[pos:pos+40],data[pos+40:pos+60],flags&0x3000);pos=start+((end-start+1+7)//8)*8
  return out
 previous=entries(before);after=entries(alternate.read_bytes());unchanged=[p for p in previous.keys()&after.keys() if previous[p][1:]==after[p][1:]];assert len(unchanged)>28000 and all(previous[p][0]==after[p][0] for p in unchanged)
 record.update(status='pushed_before_metadata_adoption',commit=new,remote_master_observed=observed,original_index_backup=(folder/'original.index').relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),preserved_unchanged_stat_entries=len(unchanged));write_json(receipt_path,record)
 fd=os.open(indexlock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY);owns=True
 try:
  assert index.read_bytes()==before and git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==old
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:fd=None;f.write(alternate.read_bytes());f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
  git('update-ref','-m','Adopt validated isolated rebase of unpublished LOW progress','refs/heads/master',new,old);os.replace(indexlock,index);owns=False
  assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==new and not git('diff','--cached','--name-only',new).strip()
 finally:
  if fd is not None:os.close(fd)
  if owns and indexlock.exists():indexlock.unlink()
 record.update(status='committed_pushed_revalidated_primary_adopted',completed_at_utc=utc_now(),working_file_writes=0,files_committed=len(staged));write_json(receipt_path,record)
except BaseException:
 record.update(status='requires_explicit_reconciliation',observed_at_utc=utc_now(),error=traceback.format_exc());write_json(receipt_path,record);raise
finally:
 assert read_json(lock)['process_id']==os.getpid();lock.unlink()
print(json.dumps({'status':record['status'],'commit':record['commit'],'files_committed':record['files_committed'],'preserved_unchanged_stat_entries':record['preserved_unchanged_stat_entries']}),flush=True)
